$comment: Configures which YouTube channels and playlists are pulled into src/data/judoClips.ts. Each entry uses one of three forms: channelHandle (e.g. '@JudoTV'), channelId (UC...), or playlistId (PL...). Add or remove entries to curate the pool. The fetch script (scripts/fetch-judo-clips.mjs) calls the YouTube Data API and filters to embeddable, kid-appropriate videos.
